name: JAL LOCHAN: AI Acoustic Debris Detection System
description: JAL LOCHAN: Offshore hydrographic side-scan sonar (SSS/XTF) processor featuring SRAD speckle filtering, CLAHE contrast enhancement, dual-head YOLOv8-OBB & U-Net inference, physics shadow height verification, and WGS84 geospatial export for AUV cleanup operations.
